title: A Review of Human Evaluation for Style Transfer
reasoning: The paper reviews human evaluation practices and identifies ethical issues related to research methodology as a key finding. Specifically, it highlights the lack of transparency regarding annotator compensation and, in its discussion, points to 'potential biases and ethical issues that might arise from, e.g., compensation mechanisms'. This critical examination of the ethics of crowdsourcing and human evaluation within NLP research constitutes a component of evaluating ethics.
